title: Phase 1: Python test driver foundation
description:
Implement the Python test driver foundation (Plan 22 §2, §3, §10, §12):

- tests/e2e/client.py — FlexAgentClient with Connect streaming envelope parser (§2.3, §2.5)
- tests/e2e/process.py — ProcessManager with timeouts, signal handlers, atexit cleanup (§2.4, §3)
- tests/e2e/credentials.py — Credential loading from secrets file (§10)
- tests/e2e/conftest.py — pytest fixtures for orchestrator lifecycle, session cleanup (§12)
- tests/e2e/test_connect_parser.py — Unit tests for the Connect envelope parser (§2.5)
- tests/e2e/requirements.txt — pytest, requests, pytest-timeout

Key design concerns: agent-safe (no interactive sessions), timeouts at every layer (§3.2), automatic cleanup on failure (§3.3), idempotent runs (§3.5).

References: docs/plans/22-e2e-external-tests.md §2-3, §10, §12
